summary: Godrej Consumer Products has launched a new manufacturing facility in Kendal, Indonesia, backed by an investment of IDR 500 billion.

summary: Transformers & Rectifiers India Ltd will discuss its unaudited standalone and consolidated results for Q2FY27 and H1FY27 in a conference call scheduled for October 13, 2026.

summary: Krupalu Metals Limited appointed Sumita Mansukhbhai Solanki as Additional Non-Executive Director. Anjali Hukam Bhai Jeshani resigned from the same role effective October 6, 2026.

summary: Kanohar Electricals aims for FY27 revenue of around ₹950 crore, targeting an EBITDA margin in line with FY26 levels.
